statistics.bootstrap: 10,000 draws seed 20261018, blocks resampled, trials nested (scripts/amd/cubw/analyze.py ratio_ci)
statistics.noninferiority: upper 95% CI of R = T(cell)/T(stock 304, same block) <= 1.05 AND clock_ok AND placement_ok AND identical outputs; otherwise observational

gates.release_g1: placement_ok (every mask: exact distinct CUs, per-XCD counts within 1)
gates.release_g5: placement_ok and lifecycle_ok and isolation: leak_ok_v4 (v1.6 rule, tuned decoder, every GPU and level) if leak v4 is sensitive on every GPU/level; on gfx942 only, if leak v4 is insensitive anywhere, leak_ok_v2 (v1.3 rule, tuned decoder) instead; else false
gates.clock_ok: unchanged: pooled in-window gfx and memory clocks max/min <= 1.05, coverage >= 0.5

retry_policy: two attempts maximum, only for execution/tool failures; correctness failures never retried
